name: Network Connection Enumeration
summary: Adversaries may perform network connection enumeration to discover information about device communication patterns. If an adversary can inspect the state of a network connection with tools, such as Netstat, in conjunction with System Firmware, then they can determine the role of certain devices on the network . The adversary can also use Network Sniffing to watch network traffic for details about the source, destination, protocol, and content.

analytics.name: Analytic 1902
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies execution of network enumeration commands (netstat, arp -a, Get-NetTCPConnection) on an Industrial Control System (ICS) host from an account not associated with documented network administration, where multiple such commands execute in sequence within a short window. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering…
